title: The metasfresh integration is positioned as an add-on the partner resells, not a competing store
content:
The mechanism is a metasfresh callout dispatching a typed operation on document completion. Document completion is the ERP's own notion of a finished business fact, so the record boundary is the product's rather than an imposed one.

The recorded framing is commercial: offered as a metasfresh add-on they resell, not a competing store. For a partner whose business includes distributing metasfresh extensions, arriving as another channel is an obstacle regardless of technical merit; arriving as inventory for the existing channel is not. The distinction costs nothing technically and changes who has to be convinced.

The single lead is metas GmbH, based in Bonn and Cologne with a Romanian presence, marked "2 · next". Together with the Abilian proposal — Switchboard packaged for the partner's own PaaS catalogue — it forms a small pattern in the corpus of shipping through the partner's existing distribution rather than beside it.
